ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: The image shows a rectangular piece of paper, with an interior point in the middle. The problem states that Rebecca drew 4 different straight lines, and these 4 straight lines all pass through the same point. The geometric rule is: n different concurrent straight lines will divide the plane into 2n regions, because each time a new straight line passing through the common point is added, two opposite new sector-shaped regions will be formed. Here n = 4, so the number of regions is 2 × 4 = 8.
